from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        swc = operator.StarWithCoordinator(worker_llm=self.llm, coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_DECRYPT_COORD_PROMPT] * 3,
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.COORD_DECRYPT_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await swc(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=3,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.VERIFY_DECRYPT_PROMPT, prompt_custom.NORMALIZE_PLAINTEXT_PROMPT, prompt_custom.FORMAT_ONLY_PROMPT])
        final = await seq(problem + "\n\nCurrent candidate answer:\n" + draft["response"])
        return final["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
